title: Hotfix: relax HTTP/2 per-stream idle timeout for SSE (OpenAI compat)
author: maya_srinivasan
description:
Context
- SUP-2988: HelioBank Dedicated seeing RST_STREAM mid-response on stream=true /v1/chat/completions.
- Root cause appears to be overly aggressive per-stream idle timeout + write timeout behavior for SSE over HTTP/2.

Changes
- Increase h2 per-stream idle timeout for SSE routes (OpenAI compat listener).
- Ensure periodic flush for token deltas to prevent intermediaries marking the stream idle.
- Add metric tag sse_route=true for stream reset counters.

Testing
- Added an integration test that streams 60s worth of deltas and asserts no reset.
- Verified in staging behind the same edge proxy config.

Rollout
- Cherry-pick into release/2025.01 and deploy to helio dedicated pool first.

Review conversation
- david_kim: Can we keep the timeout scoped only to SSE paths?
- maya_srinivasan: Yes, the change only applies to /v1/chat/completions stream=true and /v1/responses stream=true.
- ethan_park: Looks good; please add a note about HTTP/1.1 fallback in docs follow-up.

Merge
- Squash merged; will deploy with api-gateway hotfix window.
